","poster":"data:image/jpeg;base64,"},{"id":15,"name":"Чертёж поверх фото","benefit":"Контуры здания и план-сетка","method":"Контуры OpenCV, без ИИ","selected":false,"video":"effect_15.mp4","src":"data:video/mp4;base64,","poster":"data:image/jpeg;base64,"}];
let saved=[];try{saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ace_gallery_picks')||'[]')}catch{}const selected=new Set(saved);let showOnly=false;let opened=0;
const grid=document.getElementById('grid');const viewer=document.getElementById('viewer');const dlgvideo=document.getElementById('dlgvideo');
function toast(t){let el=document.getElementById('toast');el.textContent=t;el.style.display='block';setTimeout(()=>el.style.display='none',1800)}
function count(){document.getElementById('count').innerHTML='Выбрано: '+selected.size+'<small>эффектов из 15</small>';}
function card(e){let el=document.createElement('article');el.className='card'+(selected.has(e.id)?' checked':'');el.dataset.id=e.id;el.innerHTML=`<div class="visual"><video preload="none" playsinline muted loop poster="${e.poster}" aria-label="Видео: ${e.name}"></video><span class="num">#${String(e.id).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span class="dur">4 сек · демо</span><button class="play" aria-label="Смотреть ${e.name}">▶</button></div><div class="body"><h2 class="t">${e.name}</h2><p class="desc">${e.benefit}</p><div class="method">${e.method}</div><div class="actions"><button class="pick ${selected.has(e.id)?'on':''}">${selected.has(e.id)?'✓ Выбрано':'+ Выбрать'}</button></div></div>`;
const v=el.querySelector('video');v.src=e.src;el.querySelector('.play').addEventListener('click',()=>openView(e.id));v.addEventListener('click',()=>openView(e.id));el.querySelector('.pick').addEventListener('click',()=>pick(e.id));return el}
function render(){grid.replaceChildren(...effects.filter(e=>!showOnly||selected.has(e.id)).map(card));count();if(!grid.children.length){grid.textContent='Пока ничего не выбрано.'}observe()}
let observer=null;function observe(){if(observer)observer.disconnect();observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{for(let entry of entries){const v=entry.target;if(entry.isIntersecting && !viewer.open){v.play().catch(()=>{});}else v.pause()}},{threshold:.45});grid.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(v=>observer.observe(v))}
function pick(id){const was=selected.has(id);if(was)selected.delete(id);else selected.add(id);localStorage.setItem('ace_gallery_picks',JSON.stringify([...selected]));toast((was?'Удалено: ':'Добавлено: ')+effects.find(e=>e.id===id).name);const card=grid.querySelector(`[data-id="${id}"]`);if(card){card.classList.toggle('checked',selected.has(id));let b=card.querySelector('.pick');b.classList.toggle('on',selected.has(id));b.textContent=selected.has(id)?'✓ Выбрано':'+ Выбрать';if(showOnly&&!selected.has(id))card.remove()}count();if(viewer.open&&opened===id)document.getElementById('dlgselect').textContent=selected.has(id)?'✓ Выбрано':'+ Выбрать'}
function openView(id){const e=effects.find(x=>x.id===id);opened=id;grid.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(v=>v.pause());document.getElementById('dlgtitle').textContent=e.name;document.getElementById('dlgdesc').textContent=e.benefit+' · '+e.method;document.getElementById('dlgselect').textContent=selected.has(id)?'✓ Выбрано':'+ Выбрать';dlgvideo.src=e.src;viewer.showModal();dlgvideo.play().catch(()=>{})}
function closeView(){dlgvideo.pause();dlgvideo.removeAttribute('src');dlgvideo.load();viewer.close();observe()}
function selectionText(){const arr=effects.filter(e=>selected.has(e.id));return 'ACE / МОИ ЭФФЕКТЫ — '+arr.length+' из 15\n\n'+arr.map(e=>`${e.id}. ${e.name} — ${e.benefit}`).join('\n')+'\n\nИсточник: ACE Motion Lab, 20.11.2026'}
function showExport(){const t=selectionText();document.getElementById('exportText').textContent=t;document.getElementById('exportDialog').showModal()}
document.getElementById('copyBtn').addEventListener('click',async()=>{const s=selectionText();try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(s);toast('Выбор скопирован: '+selected.size)}catch(e){showExport()}});
document.getElementById('dlgselect').addEventListener('click',()=>pick(opened));document.getElementById('closeView').addEventListener('click',closeView);viewer.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===viewer)closeView()});viewer.addEventListener('close',()=>{dlgvideo.pause();observe()});document.getElementById('closeExport').addEventListener('click',()=>document.getElementById('exportDialog').close());render();
</script></body></html>
